gang_fight.description: Gang fights in arenas: propose, accept, decline, enlist, drop, info, arenas, stats.

gang_fight_propose.description: Challenge another gang to a fight of <size> per side; the bet leaves both banks when they accept.

gang_fight_enlist.description: Join your gang's side in the fight lobby.

gang_fight_drop.description: Leave the fight lobby before the countdown.

gang_fight_info.description: Your gang's challenge or fight: sides, bet, arena, time left.

arena.description: Staff: build and manage fight arenas.

arena_corner.description: Set a corner of the arena box where you stand (twice).

arena_spawn.description: Add a spawn for side a or b where you stand.

arena_exit.description: Set where fighters return after a fight.

arena_finish.description: Check and save the draft (place arenas outside turfs).

arena_show.description: Show an arena's box as particles.

arena_reload.description: Reload fight/arenas.yml after a hand edit.
